name: Papa to Musume no Seikyouiku * Jissen Komi
original_name: パパと娘の性教育※実践込み
source:
Daddy's little girl suddenly has grown-up questions!
It seems her friend's been doing naughty things with daddy.
Damned however he answers, he dabbles in his daughter, too.
In the name of education......

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE172471.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
爸爸的小女孩突然有了成年人的问题！
她的朋友似乎和爸爸做过下流的事。
无论爸爸如何回答，他也会对女儿下手。

以教育之名……

[来自 [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE172471.html]DLsite英文页面[/url]]
